claims.claim: Nikon z fc (retro-inspired, SLR-style mirrorless) with 20.9-megapixel APS-C sensor
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Nikon camera body and attached lens, but the exact model (Z fc) and sensor specs are not readable.
No shutter count display or menu screen is shown/readable in the witness report.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Witness report does not include a clear lens inspection close-up sufficient to confirm absence of fungus/scratches.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a battery pack and a memory card, but does not show a charger or any repair/warranty documentation.

risks.risk: Exact camera model is not confirmed (could be a different Nikon body), which changes value significantly.
risks.proof: A photo of the camera showing the model name/number on the body (e.g., Z fc marking) and/or the EXIF/menu “About” screen with model details.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unconfirmed Nikon mirrorless body with attached lens (worst-case generic/unknown model), assuming typical used condition and no premium for Z fc.

risks.risk: Lens model/condition is not confirmed; haze/fungus/oil/scratches may exist even if not obvious in the provided angles.
risks.proof: A macro/straight-on shot of the lens glass (front and rear if possible) plus a video clip panning focus to show clarity and any internal haze/fungus.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used camera with lens of unknown condition; treat lens as potentially needing cleaning/with minor optical issues.

risks.risk: Functional status is unknown (shutter, autofocus, metering, flash, IBIS, buttons/ports).
risks.proof: A short video showing: power on, menu navigation, autofocus lock on a subject, taking a photo, and playback of the image; include a quick flash test if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/unknown working status (worst-case), reducing value accordingly.

risks.risk: Sensor condition is unknown (dust, scratches, spots).
risks.proof: A photo of the sensor cleaning/dust check image (if the camera has it) or a close inspection shot through the sensor area (with lens removed) under bright light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential sensor dust/spotting risk (worst-case), since it can require cleaning.

risks.risk: Accessories completeness is unknown (charger, cables, strap, caps, box/manual).
risks.proof: A full laid-out photo of everything included, clearly showing charger model, cables, strap, and all caps/cover pieces.
risks.if_unproven: Price with only what is shown (battery pack + memory card + lens caps), assuming charger/cables/strap/box are not included.

risks.risk: Memory card details and whether it’s included/working are unclear.
risks.proof: A photo showing the memory card label/capacity and a quick clip showing the camera reading it (playback or format screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming the card may be low capacity or unverified; value treated as minimal/uncertain.

risks.risk: Battery health/charge capacity is unknown; battery may be worn or not original.
risks.proof: A photo of battery info (if available) and a clip showing battery level dropping during use, plus a clear shot of battery model/label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used battery with unknown health (worst-case), not counting on long runtime.

risks.risk: Ownership/serial number match and warranty status are unknown; could be stolen/grey-market.
risks.proof: A photo of the camera serial number and a matching receipt/warranty card (or proof of purchase) with personal details redacted.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no warranty/proof of ownership provided; treat as higher risk for buyer.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the camera body showing the exact model name/number (e.g., Z fc) and/or the “About” screen with model details.
A close-up/macro inspection of the lens glass (front and rear if possible) and a short focus/recording video to confirm optical clarity.
A short functional test video: power on, menu navigation, autofocus lock, take a photo, and playback of the image.
A sensor dust check image or a bright-light sensor inspection shot (lens removed) to confirm sensor condition.
A full accessories lay-out photo showing whether the charger is included (and its model), plus any cables/strap/box/manual.
Photo of the memory card label (capacity) and a clip showing the camera reading it (playback or format screen).
Photo of the battery label/model and a clip showing battery level behavior during use.
Photo of the serial number and any proof of purchase/warranty documentation (with sensitive info redacted).
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Nikon camera body with an attached lens and some basic accessories, so it can be priced at a worst-case used level. However, the seller’s specific claims (Z fc, shutter count, lens cleanliness, charger/originality, no repairs) are not verifiable from the witness report, so the price should reflect unknown model/condition and untested functionality.
